STOPPED before claim. The task forbids changes under `.github/` and `scripts/`.

I checked upstream/main at 68d6452612. The gate job already has a 90-minute timeout in `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`.
The report script `.github/scripts/post-merge-report.sh` has no runner identity input. It uses a generic message when no FAIL row exists.

The overlap checks found no open PR for these two files.

Runner stop, 2026-11-22: post-merge run 45028887961 (commit 49aaaaa60) on runner `uma`. The job `gate` ended as a failure at 13:57:29Z, 15 minutes after its start. The step "Batch gate tier" has no conclusion and no log, and the gate summary has no FAIL row. The workflow opened #3440 for it. I started the run again one time (attempt 2, on `len-pm`).

Cause found for the uma stop at 13:47 UTC (run of `49aaaaa60`, #3440): **systemd-oomd killed the runner's service**, not a CamCraft failure. From uma's journal (runner user unit):

```
05:47:49 uma systemd[1723]: actions-runner.service: systemd-oomd killed some process(es) in this unit.
05:47:49 uma systemd[1723]: actions-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

uma (61 GB) was running the gate's build while our pool builds were still running on the same host (the pause stops new pool jobs, not running ones), so memory pressure crossed oomd's limit and it picked the runner's cgroup. Nothing was logged because the whole unit was SIGKILLed, which matches "no conclusion and no log".

Mitigation applied on uma (mkinney side): the pool user's slice is capped (`user-<uid>.slice MemoryHigh=30G MemoryMax=40G`), so under pressure the pool builds are throttled or killed first and the runner keeps its memory. The skull 63-minute hang is still open; next step there is the same journal check for that time window.

- Run 45030157538 (commit 6679b1b4b), runner `skull`: the step "Batch gate tier" was in progress from 13:57:09Z to 14:49Z (52 minutes), with no FAIL row.

I cancelled only these two runs. I did not start them again: the runs on 58ecbebb0 (contains 49aaaaa60) and on 5326584a7 (contains 6679b1b4b) are green.

Runner log, 2026-11-22: the runner `egg` cannot complete the batch tier in the step limit of 75 minutes when the `app` test binaries must be built.

Run 45051365934 (commit 6e641dac7, the tip of `main`), job `gate` on `egg`, 17:47:03Z to 19:02:40Z:
- "gate step TIMEOUT after 75 min; last started step: [484] app suites: circular_stay_down". No FAIL row and no STALL row. Each step that ran is green.
- Build steps: geometry 25 s, kernel 41 s, cl 4 s, tools 11 s, post 164 s, sim 88 s, motion 196 s, **app 3199 s (53 minutes)**, gpu 49 s, ui 209 s. The builds took about 66 minutes of the 75.
- The test steps are fast on this runner: about 470 steps in the last 9 minutes.
- `egg` builds with `-j 12`. The earlier run 45045638947 on `egg` (commit deb5364ee) also ended in the `app` build, at the old limit of 45 minutes.

For comparison, run 45051255800 (commit 43217a7c4) on the runner `cheese` is green in 64 minutes for all steps.

What this means:
- The cause is not a stop of the runner. The `app` build of about 650 test binaries takes 53 minutes on `egg`. With the tests after it, the run needs about 85 to 90 minutes. That is over the step limit of 75 and near the job limit of 90.
- A second run on `egg` is faster only if the `app` test binaries of the same commit are still in its `target/`.

Action: the run is started again one time (19:05Z). If it ends on the limit again, the main session asks the maintainer about a higher limit, a lighter post-merge tier, or the removal of `egg` from the label `camcraft-post-merge`.
